title: Shared room-block interface segments for route-qualified upper-suite proposals
interpretation: Geometric interface inventory only; measured projected room-face overlap spans across a documented nominal wall allowance are not wall openings or door clear widths.
owner_direction: U-03 private route only through U-02
test_shell: 38.333333 x 40 ft exploration case only; not selected house dimensions
ranking: Descending minimum, median, then total of six face-overlap spans; then lower maximum nominal wall allowance. Ties are ordered by layout key. Descriptive geometry ranking only.
limitations: Finite-grid M164 candidates and sampled 4 ft public-route evidence only.
The M37 source defines a 0.5 ft nominal wall allowance; the measured gap and face-overlap interval do not establish an authored wall or suitable wall assembly.
Interface spans are not door clear widths and do not establish opening position, swing, privacy, egress, accessibility or usable circulation.
No room layout, M-06 fixture, wall assembly, floor/eave datum, roof assembly, structural condition, or code pass/fail is selected or evaluated. Selected-D remains unchanged.
